# `Scanner/SNRSpec-v0` · Meet a signal-to-noise requirement in the shortest scan time

**D · Image quality and artefacts** · quality · kind 2, set · isolates D5: SNR, resolution and scan time: what each costs the others. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** ADMITTED: on 300 fresh instances per level the reference passes >= 97 %, no policy that ignores the object passes more than 3 % (95 % bounds)

The everyday protocol question: this much SNR at this pixel size, as fast as possible. Signal and noise have to be measured on cheap scans and scaled with the SNR laws (voxel volume, lines, averages, bandwidth); the repetition time trades recovery of the hidden T1 against time, the bandwidth trades noise against decay of the hidden T2 over a longer echo time, and averages come in integers. This is a measurement task: a fixed list of scans with a fixed solver passes within 25 points of the reference at every level (reference minus open loop, points: 0 at level 1, 1 at level 2, 0 at level 3; 300 instances per level).

Kind of task: **{'kind': 'measurement', 'evidence': 'reference minus open_loop, points of pass rate: 0 at level 1, 1 at level 2, 0 at level 3 (n = 300 per level, engine mrgym-engine-0.3.0)'}**.

```python
import mrgym
env = mrgym.make("Scanner/SNRSpec-v0", level=2, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| A test object with vials of hidden materials; the scanner; a scan-time budget for probing | For each of two spin-echo images of prescribed geometry: repetition time, number of averages and receiver bandwidth | Noise-free scans of the delivered protocols on the hidden object with the analytic noise of the hidden receiver: every marked region must reach its required SNR, in a scan time within a stated factor of the shortest that does (exhaustive search on the hidden world) |

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (a disc of gel with vials), 1.5 T
- Sequences that matter here: se
- Formulas the agent is given: from the datasheet: the spin-echo signal mechanism (recovery with the repetition time, exp(-TE / T2), the slice profile), the scan-time rule, noise variance proportional to the receiver bandwidth. Not given: how SNR scales with voxel size, lines and averages, and the statistics of the magnitude of noise

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| T1, T2 and proton density of every material | the geometry of the two images |
| receiver noise level | the regions and the required SNR of each image |
| transmit gain and B1 pattern | the definition of SNR |
| receive profile | the allowed scan-time factor |
| off-resonance field | the instrument datasheet |
| the 128-bit world seed | realised protocol, timing and cost of every plan and scan |

## Levels

| Level | Covered by the claim | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | yes | one average is enough: how short can the repetition time be for the hidden T1 and the hidden noise | 330 |
| 2 | yes | several averages are needed: repetition time and the integer number of averages are chosen together | 330 |
| 3 | yes | as levels 1 and 2 with short-T2 materials: the narrowest bandwidth is no longer the best one | 330 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'A': {'tr_ms': '<milliseconds>', 'averages': '<integer>', 'bandwidth_hz_per_px': '<hertz per pixel>'}, 'B': {'tr_ms': '<milliseconds>', 'averages': '<integer>', 'bandwidth_hz_per_px': '<hertz per pixel>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; the console accepts both delivered scans
- Error: `summed scan time of the delivered scans, seconds (the oracle's T* is the shortest sufficient sum)`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates and, for each image, SNR >= the requirement in both regions and scan time <= 1.15 x the shortest sufficient one

## Gate: the control policies on fresh instances

## What the agent reads at reset (level 2, seed 0)

~~~text
# Meet a signal-to-noise requirement in the shortest scan time
A test object with vials of unknown materials lies in the field of
view. The examination needs 2 spin-echo images, A and B. Each has a prescribed geometry and a required signal-to-noise
ratio (SNR) in two marked regions:
    image A: sequence se, fov_mm 240, matrix 96 (pixel 2.5 mm), slice_mm 5; SNR at least 131 in R1 and R2
    image B: sequence se, fov_mm 240, matrix 160 (pixel 1.5 mm), slice_mm 5; SNR at least 93 in R3 and R4
For each image you choose tr_ms, averages and bandwidth_hz_per_px. Everything else is fixed: the fields above, te_ms at
the console minimum for the bandwidth you choose, full k-space, every other parameter at its default.
Regions (circles; centre and radius in mm from the isocentre; each lies inside one homogeneous material):
  R1: y 13.96, x 51.26, radius 11.5
  R2: y -48.3, x 30.43, radius 11.5
  R3: y 13.77, x -51.22, radius 11.5
  R4: y -46.54, x -32.76, radius 11.5
SNR of a region = magnitude of the mean complex signal of the region's pixels / standard deviation of the noise in one pixel, one channel (real or imaginary part).
Deliver the three numbers for each image with `submit`. The images are not run in this episode: the scanner evaluates
the protocols you deliver. Your own scans may use any sequence and any parameters the console accepts; only the deliverable is evaluated, on the scan the task names. That scan is not charged to the scan-time budget and not limited by it.
Nothing about the materials, the noise or the state of the system is known in advance.

Passing: for each image, (1) every one of its regions reaches the required SNR, evaluated on a noise-free scan of your
protocol with the noise level of this scanner, and (2) its scan time is at most 1.15 times the shortest scan time
with which any choice of tr_ms, averages and bandwidth_hz_per_px meets (1). The scanner's log must show that you
measured. An answer in the wrong unit is wrong.

Limits. Scan time: 330 s (only `scan` spends it). Tool calls: 48 (every call counts once unless rejected). Rejected calls: 8 (a call refused for how it is written: unknown name, wrong type; costs nothing else), of them at most 3 refused `submit` calls. The episode ends at `submit` or at a limit; without `submit` the score is 0.
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier's scans are noise-free and its noise is analytic.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
